errors.evidence: The title in the figure is 'Distribution of data source in the combined training set'. The description adds 'and AttrEval-Simulation sets', which is external information not present in the image itself.
The data source with a value of 11.3% is MULTINLI, not MULTIFC. MULTIFC's actual value is 0.5%.
The description incorrectly states that SCIFACT (0.1%) is colored yellow. In the chart, the SCIFACT slice is light blue/grey. The yellow slice corresponds to ENTFA (1.8%).
The description incorrectly states that ENTFA (1.8%) is colored dark green. In the chart, the ENTFA slice is yellow/gold. The green slice corresponds to FACTCC (2.6%).
The description incorrectly states that FACTCC (2.6%) is colored dark orange. In the chart, the FACTCC slice is green. The orange slice corresponds to ANLI (4.6%).
The description incorrectly states that ANLI (4.6%) is colored dark red. In the chart, the ANLI slice is orange. The rose/reddish slice corresponds to MULTINLI (11.3%).
